Conversion Kit — £1100 inc. VATSecond Wave Conversions — £1495 inc. VAT

Turn your 90s steel MTB into a capable cargo bike with the CarryON — a workshop-built steel front end designed and made in East London.

Two ways to CarryON:

• Kit-only — shipped worldwide for installation by your local framebuilder

• Second Wave Conversions (17-28 August 2026) — workshop installation at Stayer, East London.

Secure your CarryON with a 50% deposit.

The Stayer CarryON is a steel cargo conversion system designed and built in our East London workshop to give classic 90s 26″ MTBs a second life.

Its geometry draws inspiration from early cargo conversion work by Stephen Bilenky, whose long-wheelbase cargo builds influenced modern front-loading bike design — reinterpreted here through a workshop-built steel front end refined for everyday riding.

CarryON is modular, strong, and built specifically around steel MTB frames.

It’s for the bikes with stories — the ones ridden hard, stored away, and not quite finished yet.

Now they can carry on.

CarryON exists because we’ve spent years designing, cutting and brazing steel frames in our East London workshop.

If you’d rather build one yourself, you can now do exactly that. Our Build Your Own CarryON Cargo Bike course takes you through converting your own steel MTB into a CarryON over five hands-on days in the Stayer workshop.

You’ll do the brazing yourself, cut out the original front end and build the conversion with us.

→ Build Your Own: CarryON

Shippable worldwide · 2 month turnaround

A complete front-end cargo conversion kit for your local framebuilder to install. Designed for straightforward installation by an experienced framebuilder onto most steel 26″ MTB frames.
